newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda Sept domestic output up 27.3% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Honda Sept domestic output up 27.3% yr/yr.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said its domestic vehicle production, exports, domestic sales and overseas output in September were as follows (comparisons are with year ago):
Honda's domestic output rose in September for the third straight month year-on-year, mainly due to higher domestic sales and an increase in exports of Civics to North America.
Domestic sales rose due to strong demand for Honda's recreational vehicle series -- Step Wagon, CR-V, Accord Wagon and Orthia.
Honda's exports rose in September due to strong demand for the Civic sedan in North America. Overseas production climbed for the eighth straight month due to higher output in North America and Asia.
